title: Upside Down No More
style: Mandopop-pop with buoyant four-on-the-floor kick, plucky synth hooks, light acoustic guitar, and syncopated clap snaps; verse stays airy and conversational, pre-chorus lifts with filtered pads and rising vocal stacks, chorus lands bright with a singalong hook and gang doubles. Lead vocal is close-mic with crisp doubles, playful ad-libs, and short delay throws on key lines. Sparkly risers, reversed cymbal swells, and little bell turns keep it glossy and upbeat; mix is bright, wide, and radio-clean., pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Oi, I copped that look from you
Like, “mate, what’s the move?”
I got my words all jumbled up
In my throat, in my boots

I said “yeah, nah,” then “nah, yeah”
Bit of a mess, truth be told
But I’m tryna keep it tidy
Keep it warm, keep it bold

You don’t need a speech, nah
Just a line that lands alright
Straight from the heart, no drama
Keep it sweet and keep it light

[Pre-Chorus]
Say it plain, don’t play it sly
No smoke, no spin, no alibi
If the room goes quiet tonight
We can still get it right

[Chorus]
Safe and sound, not upside down
Safe and sound, don’t let it spin around
Say it now, say it out loud
Safe and sound, not upside down

Safe and sound, that’s the way
Safe and sound, come what may
No more doubt, clear as day
Safe and sound, we’ll be okay

[Verse 2]
I’m no flash talker, nah
I’m just learning how to land
One good word can do the job
If it comes from where I stand

So if I fumble, let me
Take a breath and start again
I can say it straight, no worries
I can meet you where you’re at, my friend

You don’t need a perfect line
Just the truth in a steady tone
If the vibe feels rough and rattled
I’ll keep it calm, keep it known

[Pre-Chorus]
Say it plain, don’t play it sly
No smoke, no spin, no alibi
If the room goes quiet tonight
We can still get it right

[Chorus]
Safe and sound, not upside down
Safe and sound, don’t let it spin around
Say it now, say it out loud
Safe and sound, not upside down

Safe and sound, that’s the way
Safe and sound, come what may
No more doubt, clear as day
Safe and sound, we’ll be okay

[Bridge]
Maybe I’ve been talking circles
Wearing holes in what I mean
But you and me, we know the feeling
When the truth comes in clean

So I’ll drop the noise, drop the show
Keep the line nice and true
If you’re asking what to say, mate
I’ll say I’m right here with you

[Final Chorus]
Safe and sound, not upside down
Safe and sound, don’t let it spin around
Say it now, say it out loud
Safe and sound, not upside down

Safe and sound, that’s the way
Safe and sound, come what may
No more doubt, clear as day
Safe and sound, we’ll be okay

Safe and sound, not upside down
Safe and sound, not upside down
Say it now, say it proud
Safe and sound, we’ll be okay
